deviations.description: Pass the augmented JSON as skill_orchestrate_propagate_completion's 5th argument in place of "${recover_json:-}" on this branch only; leave the non-skeleton call site byte-for-byte unchanged.
deviations.reason: Implemented as two separate call sites in an if/else on skeleton_active (one per branch) rather than a single shared completion_precomputed_json variable feeding one call, so the non-skeleton call's own two-line statement is textually identical to before -- same arguments, same behavior -- but its indentation shifted by 2 spaces because it is now nested one level deeper inside the new if/else. Chosen over the single-variable approach specifically so the non-skeleton behavior stays provably identical rather than merely equal-by-construction.
